description: Environment setup and baseline verification for Public/frontend-v6. Confirm the toolchain works and the current build/check/test baseline is green before making changes.
steps: PREPEND to PATH: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" (node v22.23.2 must be on PATH).
cd Public/frontend-v6. node_modules is already present; run `npm ci` only if a dependency issue appears.
Run `npm run check` and confirm 0 errors / 0 warnings (svelte-check --fail-on-warnings).
Run `npm test` and confirm all existing vitest suites pass.

Run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds. Measure total client JS with: find build/_app/immutable -name '*.js' -printf '%s\n' | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}'. Record the number (baseline observed = 622183 bytes; budget = 700000).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run check` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings
`npm run build` completes successfully and total client JS is under 700000 bytes
Baseline JS byte total is recorded in findings
verification: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
findings:
Baseline verified GREEN on node v22.23.2 in Public/frontend-v6 (node_modules already present, no npm ci needed).
- `npm run check`: svelte-check found 0 errors and 0 warnings (--fail-on-warnings). Note: a harmless non-blocking Vite configLoader warning about importing './src/lib/ratings' without a file extension is printed but does NOT count as a svelte-check warning; exit code 0.
- `npm test`: 16 test files, 295 tests, all passed (exit 0). Slowest suite is src/lib/skins/lazy.test.ts (~13.5s). Total run ~14.4s.
- `npm run build`: succeeded via @sveltejs/adapter-static, wrote to build/.
- Total client JS: `find build/_app/immutable -name '*.js' -printf '%s\n' | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s}'` = 622179 bytes. Under 700000 budget (~77.8KB headroom). Orchestrator observed 622183; the 4-byte delta is normal run-to-run variance.
No source files modified. Nothing committed/pushed per instructions.
